# Need drift along a lineage

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`need-drift-along-a-lineage` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](need-drift-along-a-lineage.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Along a lineage each member depending on c with its need not rising until it gives, transmission within δ keeps the need after i + 1 descents within the founder's need, or the level where the founder was supported, plus (i + 1) δ.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With the dependence transmitted within δ, each member descending, depending on c at its first standing step, and its need not rising until it gives in turn, the need after i + 1 descents is at most the founder's plus (i + 1) δ, or the level where the founder was supported plus (i + 1) δ. (`Becoming.Flow.transmitted_along`, `Becoming.Flow.transmitted_along_supported`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; descents as given; whole-number needs.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That actual inheritance drifts by at most a fixed δ.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
